fields.name: PgParameters materialized Npgsql parameter
fields.description: The parameter record PgParameters appends to a DbParameterCollection. Its direction and PostgreSQL type determine whether it carries an input value or reserves an output value; Size, Precision, Scale, and element type are supplied only by applicable type families.

members.name: name
members.description: The caller-supplied parameter name after PgParameters normalization.

members.name: direction
members.description: Input for value-bearing helpers and output for retrieval helpers.

members.name: postgresType
members.description: The Npgsql PostgreSQL type selected by the helper family.

members.name: value
members.description: The supplied typed input value, or System.DBNull.Value for an absent nullable input; output parameters do not receive an input value.

members.name: size
members.description: The declared length for applicable Varchar, Char, and Bytea variants.

members.name: precision
members.description: The declared decimal precision for Numeric variants.

members.name: scale
members.description: The declared decimal scale for Numeric variants.

members.name: elementPostgresType
members.description: The array element PostgreSQL type for Array variants.

representations.C#: NpgsqlParameter or NpgsqlParameter<T> appended to DbParameterCollection; Direction maps to ParameterDirection.Input or ParameterDirection.Output.
representations.PostgreSQL: postgresType is selected from the helper family; Array combines NpgsqlDbType.Array with its element type.
